votes.motion: Approve Douglas S. Duval Sr. for the position of Constable.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved that douglas s. duval sr. be approved for the position of constable. mr. debettencourt seconded. on vote, motion carried 5 in favor, o opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Article 4, Rescind Remaining Bond Authorization for Meadow Woods.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to recommend approval. mr. debettencourt seconded. on vote motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Approve the FY12 Professional Firefighters Collective Bargaining Agreement (Article 6).
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to approve the firefighters contract. mr. sund seconded. on vote motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of the consent calendar (Annual Town Meeting Articles 1 through 6, revolving fund reauthorizations).
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to recommend the approval of the consent calendar. ms. bertram seconded. on vote motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Article 7, Accept / Hear Reports of Certain Committees.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to recommend approval. mr. sund seconded. on vote motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of the balanced budget (Article 8, FY13 Non-Override Budget), on re-vote.
votes.quote: at this time the motion on the floor made by ms. bertram was to recommend approval of the balanced budget and was seconded by mr. alonzo. upon re-vote motion carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend the revised Article 9 FY13 Override Budget.
votes.quote: ms. bertram made a motion to recommend the revised article 9 override budget. mr. alonzo seconded the motion. on vote, motion carried, 3 in favor; 2 opposed (debettencourt & sund)

votes.motion: Recommend approval of $277,432 into the stabilization fund (Article 10) if Article 9 passes.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo made the motion to recommend approval of $277,432 into the stabilization fund if article 9 passes. ms. bertram seconded the motion. on vote motion, carried 5 in favor, 0 opposed

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Article 11, School Feasibility Study & Schematic Plan Design.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo made the motion to recommend approval of article 11. ms. bertram seconded the motion. on vote motion carried, 5 in favor, o opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Article 13, FY13 Budget, Water Department Enterprise Fund.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to recommend approval of article 13. mr. alonzo seconded the motion. on vote, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Article 14, FY13 Budget, Solid Waste Disposal Enterprise Fund.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to recommend approval of article 14. ms. bertram seconded the motion. on vote, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Article 15, FY13 Budget, Sewer Department Enterprise Fund.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to recommend approval of article 15. mr. debettencourt seconded the motion.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Article 16, FY13 Capital Improvements Plan (school snow plow truck).
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to recommend approval for article 16. mr. alonzo seconded. on vote, 5 in favor, 0 opposed.

votes.motion: Recommend approval of Article 23, driveway easement along a portion of Town-owned Property.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to recommend approval of article 23. mr. alonzo seconded. on vote, motion passed, 5 in favor 0 opposed.
being no further business the board voted unanimously to adjourn the meeting at 9:45 p.m.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Matthews said tax bills have risen in Lunenburg due to the primary school and police and fire building, and that Lunenburg has fallen lower in average tax bill rankings.
budget_items.quote: mr. matthews commented on an article which was printed in the fitchburg sentinel & enterprise concerning the override and how the tax bills have risen in lunenburg

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said cost savings from combining the land use offices would be about $22,000 in salary and $15,000 in health insurance.
budget_items.quote: the cost savings would be about $22,000 in salary and $15,000 in health insurance

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expanding Assistant Tax Collector hours from 27 to 32 a week at a lower grade was discussed, with no increase in salary.
budget_items.quote: from 27 hours to 32 hours a week at a lower grade with no increase in salary.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel said a column was added to show where the $2.2M override would be allocated.
budget_items.quote: a column has been added to this article to identify where the $2.2m would be allocated

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The override budget includes $3000 for a recording secretary, which Ms. Bertram said is not enough for the hours needed.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel said that it includes $3000 for a recording secretary.

budget_items.topic: Reserve Fund use for recording secretary (Article 9)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel suggested $20,000 from the Reserve Fund to cover the extra expense, leaving a balance of $8000.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel suggested that $20,000 be used from the reserve fund to cover the extra expense. this leaves a balance of $8000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Line item 13 reduced by $8,000 and line items 39 and 57 each increased by $10,000.
budget_items.quote: it was decided to reduce line item 13 by $8,000, add $10,000 to line item 39 and add $10,000 to line item 57.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Recommended approval of $277,432 into the stabilization fund if Article 9 passes.
budget_items.quote: mr. alonzo made the motion to recommend approval of $277,432 into the stabilization fund if article 9 passes.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Matthews said maintenance and repairs for the four current school buildings come to approximately $18M.
budget_items.quote: if you add up maintenance and repairs to the four buildings it comes up to approximately $18m

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The sewer enterprise fund is not yet self-sustaining; Ms. Speidel will include the dollar amount in the article.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel will include the dollar amount in the article.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of purchasing a new truck with plow for the school department; the current truck is described as in complete disrepair.
budget_items.quote: he was also concerned about the purchasing of a new truck with plow for the school department.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Matthews was concerned that library painting and caulking was not funded in Capital Planning.
budget_items.quote: mr. matthews spoke and said he was concerned with the painting and caulking at the library that did not get funded in capital planning.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Speidel did not have the loss of revenue figure for the meeting.
budget_items.quote: ms. speidel did not have the loss of revenue figure available for this meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Senator Flanagan is seeking $150,000 from the Transportation Bond Bill; the town makes up the difference from its 25% share.
budget_items.quote: senator flanagan is trying to get $150,000 for this from the transportation bond bill and the towns will make up the difference.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three warrants were presented for approval with the amounts printed.
